purpose: Runs Squire's real set-up app at its entry point and the steps behind it in a test world with fakes for the Mac's commands, Claude Code's installer and the owner's answers: each listed problem is explained, keeps what is done and the owner's things, and resumes or repairs one installation; a step whose result cannot be confirmed runs again and is never counted done.
title: Set-up meets a problem, and steps it cannot confirm
